## testing_mode: RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions (structural test side):
- DD1: structural test asserting plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md is present and contains canonical headings

## What to Do
Create a new test script `tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh` following the pattern of `tests/docs/test-inference-signal-contracts.sh`. Add a `.test-index` entry with a RED marker.

## File to Create
`tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh`

## Test Content Pattern
Follow the existing pattern:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/assert.sh"

test_inferred_source_marker_contract() {
  local f="$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md"
  # Assertion 1: file exists
  if test -f "$f"; then actual_exists="present"; else actual_exists="missing"; fi
  assert_eq "inferred-source-marker.md exists" "present" "$actual_exists"
  # Assertion 2: Level-1 heading starts with "# Contract:" (check-contract-schemas.sh rule)
  if grep -q '^# Contract:' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then actual="present"; else actual="missing"; fi
  assert_eq "has '# Contract:' heading" "present" "$actual"
  # Assertion 3: Purpose section present (check-contract-schemas.sh rule)
  if grep -q '^## Purpose' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then actual="present"; else actual="missing"; fi
  assert_eq "has '## Purpose' section" "present" "$actual"
  # Assertion 4: Marker syntax documented
  if grep -q '<<inferred:' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then actual="present"; else actual="missing"; fi
  assert_eq "marker syntax <<inferred: documented" "present" "$actual"
  # Assertion 5: Emit site section present
  if grep -qE '^## Emit Site|^## Emitter' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then actual="present"; else actual="missing"; fi
  assert_eq "has emit site section" "present" "$actual"
  # Assertion 6: Consume sites section present
  if grep -qE '^## Consume Sites|^## Consumers|^## Consumer' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then actual="present"; else actual="missing"; fi
  assert_eq "has consume sites section" "present" "$actual"
  # Assertion 7: Lifecycle section present
  if grep -q '^## Lifecycle' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then actual="present"; else actual="missing"; fi
  assert_eq "has '## Lifecycle' section" "present" "$actual"
}

test_inferred_source_marker_contract
```

## .test-index Entry to Add
Add this line to `.test-index` (fuzzy-match is not possible: `inferredsourcemarkermd` not in `testinferredsourcemarkercontractsh`):
```
plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md:tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh [test_inferred_source_marker_contract]
```

## Test Approach
Given: `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md` does not yet exist.
When: running test_inferred_source_marker_contract.
Then: all 7 assertions FAIL (file missing, cannot grep non-existent file).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Script is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh
- [ ] Syntax check passes
  Verify: bash -n tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh
- [ ] .test-index entry with RED marker present
  Verify: grep -q 'inferred-source-marker\.md.*\[test_inferred_source_marker_contract\]' .test-index
- [ ] All assertions FAIL RED (canonical section-specific confirmation)
  Verify: bash tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh 2>&1 | grep -cE "FAIL|not ok|Assertion" | grep -qE "^[1-9]"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
